commands.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import secrets, string, subprocess

def sample(groups, length):
    chars = [secrets.choice(group) for group, count in groups for _ in range(count)]
    secrets.SystemRandom().shuffle(chars)
    return ''.join(chars)[:length]

cases = [
    ('11_chars_3_classes', [(string.ascii_uppercase,4),(string.ascii_lowercase,4),(string.digits,3)], 11),
    ('12_chars_2_classes', [(string.ascii_uppercase,6),(string.ascii_lowercase,6)], 12),
    ('12_chars_3_classes', [(string.ascii_uppercase,4),(string.ascii_lowercase,4),(string.digits,4)], 12),
]
for name, groups, length in cases:
    value = sample(groups, length)
    p = subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/pwscore'], input=value+'\n', text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    detail = (p.stderr or p.stdout).strip().replace(value, '<redacted>')
    print(f'{name}: rc={p.returncode} result={detail}')
PY

commands.command:
printf 'post_restart_boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running; printf 'policy_file\n'; cat /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/60-[REDACTED].conf; printf 'pam_integration\n'; grep -Hn 'pam_pwquality.so' /etc/pam.d/system-auth /etc/pam.d/password-auth; python3 - <<'PY'
import secrets, string, subprocess

def make(parts):
    chars=[]
    for alphabet,count in parts:
        chars.extend(secrets.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(count))
    secrets.SystemRandom().shuffle(chars)
    return ''.join(chars)

cases=[
 ('11_chars_3_classes',[(string.ascii_uppercase,4),(string.ascii_lowercase,4),(string.digits,3)],False),
 ('12_chars_2_classes',[(string.ascii_uppercase,6),(string.ascii_lowercase,6)],False),
 ('12_chars_3_classes',[(string.ascii_uppercase,4),(string.ascii_lowercase,4),(string.digits,4)],True),
]
ok=True
for name,parts,expected_accept in cases:
    value=make(parts)
    p=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/pwscore'],input=value+'\n',text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    accepted=(p.returncode==0)
    detail=(p.stderr or p.stdout).strip().replace(value,'<redacted>').replace('\n',' | ')
    print(f'{name}: accepted={str(accepted).lower()} result={detail}')
    ok = ok and (accepted == expected_accept)
print('all_policy_expectations_met='+str(ok).lower())
raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)
PY
